name: TinyZKP Fit Finder
summary: Interactive and machine-readable routing guide for choosing the first TinyZKP proof-receipt workflow and commercial path.
primary_question: Which TinyZKP path should a buyer or agent choose for one verifier-visible proof-receipt workflow?

recommendation_rules.when: verifier is none or receipt placement is not_yet
recommendation_rules.reason: A proof receipt is weak business value until a verifier and placement are named.
Private-input or unknown data boundaries need statement and design review before self-serve proving.

recommendation_rules.when: workflow is agent_platform, receipt placement is platform_native, or procurement is platform
recommendation_rules.reason: Native agent-platform distribution needs policy, verifier placement, support expectations, and spend controls.

recommendation_rules.when: workflow is custom_state, procurement is pilot, or procurement is security
recommendation_rules.reason: Custom predicates and review-sensitive workflows should prove one scoped statement before rollout.
Contractual support, reserved capacity, or production-critical proving lanes require enterprise review.

recommendation_rules.when: workflow is long_trace, trace is large or xl, volume is backfill, or alternative is self_hosted_prover
recommendation_rules.reason: Trace-step pricing is the first route when high-RAM prover operations are the alternative.
High-volume production services need throughput, discounts, and spend caps.

recommendation_rules.when: volume is medium, visibility is customer_visible, verifier is customer, or verifier is auditor
recommendation_rules.reason: Customer-visible and auditor-visible receipts justify a paid plan and ROI worksheet.

recommendation_rules.when: volume is low, workflow is api_mutation, or workflow is audit_checkpoint
recommendation_rules.reason: One production workflow should use the smallest paid route before broader rollout.
A free receipt and verifier result should answer whether the trust boundary matters.

recommended_paths.name: Free
recommended_paths.best_for: Evaluation, demos, and early agent workflows.
recommended_paths.next_artifact: One receipt URL and verifier result.

recommended_paths.name: Developer
recommended_paths.best_for: One production workflow with a known verifier.
recommended_paths.next_artifact: Receipt attached to an API response, agent output, or checkpoint.

recommended_paths.name: Pro
recommended_paths.best_for: Recurring customer-visible or auditor-visible receipt volume.

recommended_paths.name: Scale
recommended_paths.next_artifact: Volume estimate, limits review, and support-aware rollout.

recommended_paths.name: Compute
recommended_paths.best_for: Long supported traces, backfills, and high-RAM prover-operations avoidance.

recommended_paths.name: $5,000 Production Pilot
recommended_paths.best_for: Custom statements, design review, or support-sensitive rollout.
recommended_paths.next_artifact: Statement design, verifier path, success metrics, and go/no-go decision.

recommended_paths.name: Platform Rollout
recommended_paths.best_for: Agent platforms, IDEs, workflow engines, and marketplaces.
recommended_paths.next_artifact: Receipt-required tool category, agent policy, verifier placement, and rollout package.

recommended_paths.name: Enterprise
recommended_paths.best_for: Contractual support, reserved capacity, procurement, or production-critical receipt lanes.

recommended_paths.name: Defer or Compare
recommended_paths.best_for: Workflows with no clear verifier, no visible receipt placement, or enough coverage from signed logs.

evidence_packet: Receipt placement in the product, agent output, audit record, or platform policy.
Receipt artifact or planned receipt artifact.
Verifier result or planned verifier path.
Expected monthly volume and trace-size band.
Security, pricing, ROI, or platform-review assets needed by the budget owner.
guardrails: Do not put secrets, private customer data, or API keys into transparent receipt parameters.
Do not describe the default public product as private-input zero knowledge unless a documented template and masking mode are reviewed.
Do not require receipts for every agent or platform action on day one; start with high-value action categories.
Do not buy proof receipts before naming the verifier and receipt placement.
Use signed logs, hash chains, or existing audit trails when no independent verifier needs a STARK receipt.
